<style>
:root{
  --ground:#FBF6F1; --surface:#FFFFFF; --surface-2:#F6EDE6;
  --ink:#3E2E2A; --muted:#8B736B;
  --rose:#C9707F; --rose-deep:#A8505F; --rose-soft:#F8E6E6;
  --line:#EADCD2;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(62,46,42,.05), 0 14px 34px -20px rgba(62,46,42,.4);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --ground:#221A19; --surface:#2C2321; --surface-2:#352A28;
    --ink:#F3E7E1; --muted:#B49E97;
    --rose:#E79DA7; --rose-deep:#F3BCC3; --rose-soft:#3B2A2C;
    --line:#3E312E;
    --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 14px 34px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.85);
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --ground:#221A19; --surface:#2C2321; --surface-2:#352A28;
  --ink:#F3E7E1; --muted:#B49E97;
  --rose:#E79DA7; --rose-deep:#F3BCC3; --rose-soft:#3B2A2C;
  --line:#3E312E;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 14px 34px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.85);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--ground);color:var(--ink);
  font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
  font-size:17px;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%}
.wrap{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
section{padding:46px 0}
section + section{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;text-wrap:balance;font-weight:800}
h1{font-size:clamp(28px,5.6vw,41px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.032em}
h2{font-size:clamp(24px,4.5vw,32px);line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.028em}
h3{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.015em;font-weight:700}
p{margin:0}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px}
.stack-sm{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.eyebrow{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rose)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.lede{font-size:19px;line-height:1.5}
.accent{color:var(--rose-deep);font-weight:700}

.bar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ground) 90%,transparent);
  backdrop-filter:saturate(1.4) blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar-in{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.mark{font-weight:800;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
.mark em{color:var(--rose);font-style:normal}

.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;
  border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-decoration:none;
  border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform.15s,background.15s,border-color.15s}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose-deep);outline-offset:3px}
.btn-primary{background:var(--rose);color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn-primary{color:#2A1D1F}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]).btn-primary{color:#2A1D1F}}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--rose-deep);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--rose);color:var(--rose-deep)}
.btn-sm{min-height:38px;padding:8px 18px;font-size:14px}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}

.hero{padding:26px 0 44px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero-art{width:min(330px,78%);height:auto;margin:0 auto;display:block}
.hero h1{margin-top:14px}
.hero.lede{max-width:540px;margin:0 auto}
.dates{display:inline-flex;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--rose-soft);
  color:var(--rose-deep);font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px}
.hero.btns{justify-content:center}
.float{position:absolute;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;width:88px}
.f1{top:8px;left:-14px;transform:rotate(-8deg)}
.f2{top:34px;right:-16px;transform:rotate(9deg)}
@media(max-width:700px){.float{display:none}}

.pains{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px}
.pain{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 26px -22px rgba(62,46,42,.5)}
.pain img{width:62px;height:62px;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center}
.pain p{font-weight:600;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.4}

.punch{background:var(--rose-soft);border-radius:24px;padding:34px 26px;text-align:center}
.punch.big{font-size:clamp(22px,4.2vw,30px);line-height:1.22;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.028em}

.res{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:14px}
.r{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.r img{width:66px;height:66px;object-fit:contain;flex:none}
.r p{font-weight:600;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.38}

.about{display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.photo{width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;object-fit:cover;
  border:3px solid var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.about-txt{flex:1;min-width:250px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.tags span{background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;
  padding:5px 13px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}

ul.how{padding:0;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
ul.how li{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
ul.how li::before{content:"";flex:none;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rose);margin-top:10px}
ul.how-lbl li div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
ul.how-lbl strong{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
ul.how-lbl span{color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .btns{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .btns.btn{width:100%}

}

.day{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.day + .day{margin-top:20px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.dn{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;color:var(--rose);text-align:center;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.dn span{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px}

.wk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px}
.wk + .wk{margin-top:12px}
.wk img{width:70px;height:70px;object-fit:contain}
.wdate{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rose)}

.gift{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--rose);border-radius:22px;padding:26px 24px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px}
.gift ul{padding:0;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.gift li{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;font-weight:600}
.gift li::before{content:"→";color:var(--rose);font-weight:700;flex:none}

.says{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px}
.say{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:16px 16px 16px 5px;padding:11px 16px;font-size:16px;font-weight:500}

.nope{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:9px}
.nope li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}
.nope li::before{content:"×";color:var(--rose);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;line-height:1.35;flex:none}

.prices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}

.price{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.price.now{border-color:var(--rose);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.num{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.price.now.num{color:var(--rose-deep)}
.when{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.tag{align-self:flex-start;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--rose-soft);color:var(--rose-deep);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:3px}
.timer{text-align:center;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.timer b{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.perks{background:var(--rose-soft);border-radius:18px;padding:20px}
.tryit{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;text-align:center}

.final{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:32px 24px;

.final.btns{justify-content:center}
footer{padding:30px 0 56px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
footer a{color:var(--muted)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>

<script>
(function(){
  var el=document.getElementById('timer');
  var end=new Date('2026-09-20T23:59:59+03:00').getTime();
  function pad(n){return n<10?'0'+n:''+n}
  function pl(n,a,b,c){var m=n%100;if(m>=11&&m<=14)return c;var k=n%10;if(k===1)return a;if(k>=2&&k<=4)return b;return c}
  function tick(){
    var d=end-Date.now();
    if(d<=0){el.textContent='Цена 4 900 ₽ больше не действует';return}
    var days=Math.floor(d/864e5),h=Math.floor(d/36e5)%24,m=Math.floor(d/6e4)%60;
    el.innerHTML='Цена 4 900 ₽ действует ещё <b>'+days+'</b> '+pl(days,'день','дня','дней')+' <b>'+pad(h)+':'+pad(m)+'</b>';
    setTimeout(tick,30000);
  }
  tick();
})();
</script>
